name: emep_ttxh_ew
scheme_description: Full NLO EW (all one-loop graphs of the selected order, QCD-EW mixed included) in the G_mu scheme with on-shell real masses, matching OpenLoops ew_scheme=1/ew_renorm_scheme=1 and the MG5 loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM). Real on-shell mass renormalization (MadLoop complex_mass_scheme False, Recola set_on_shell_scheme, OpenLoops complex_mass_scheme=0) with all widths zero; stable top; Feynman gauge. Recola's default complex-mass scheme keeps absorptive self-energy parts in its counterterms even at zero widths and is therefore not used.
source: independent references: MadLoop/MG5_aMC 3.7.0; Recola2 2.2.5 (tree ${LOOP_REFERENCE_ROOT}/sources/recola2-2.3.0) / collier 1.2.8 / modelfile 2.2.3
scope: Independent provider references at exact on-shell decimal points; MadLoop in quadruple precision where its return code is 3xx or 4xx, double precision elsewhere (return codes 216, 328); recola as configured in its recorded settings; timings are single-run by-products, not benchmarks.
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); F_MadLoop=F_Recola+pi^2/6*D; OpenLoops truepoles=1, polenorm=0; physical couplings, no alpha extraction; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included

point_construction.construction: scratch (ew-leptons ttxh_points.py): mpmath 60 digits, Higgs at fixed |p| and direction, t t~ recoiling with the top at a fixed rest-frame direction, printed to 30 significant digits (on shell and conserved to ~1e-27)

error_metric: |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|,|Born|*coupling/(2pi)) for Laurent coefficients, |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) for Born; strict relative errors also listed per row

excluded_providers.madloop: MadLoop omits the R2 coupling R2_G0tt_b of the G0 t t~ vertex (CT vertex V_ttG02, loop particles [W+, b]): MG5_aMC's set_LoopCT_vertices adds an R2 coupling only for a loop diagram whose set of loop propagators equals its loop_particles, and in 't Hooft-Feynman gauge every b loop of the G0 t t~ vertex holds a G+- (G0 has no W W vertex), so the label never matches. Recola - MadLoop = (R2_G0tt_b/R2_G0tt) x MadLoop's R2_G0tt component in the finite part (ratio 0.8688964 at lhv = 1, to 1e-8 at the three points; components from madloop_ct_selection.py on this run); the poles agree to 1e-13. Values recorded, not used for validation.
